default/32576.htm.text: Oracle Captain John: Captain sounds like a fancy old title, doesn't it? But you know what? I'd drop it like a hot potato if I had the chance. Barely a pay-rise to be had, an' you get all the complainin' to put up with.

Q00195_SevenSignsSecretRitualOfThePriest.text: Oracle Captain John: What do you want eh, shelter from the wind? How about you toddle off 'fore I end up with bruised fists?
Oracle Captain John: Eh? Weren't nothin' else for me to give you was there? No... no. You best be off!

Oracle Captain John: Oh! Begs your pardon, just we get lots of vagrants and the like round here, see? Terribly sorry if I caused offense--wasn't my intention, 'specially not after Lady Claudia was so generous with that... donation... of hers. Here you are--that card'll get you into the Sanctum fast…
